data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed the PKGBUILD and all other repository files, confirming it is a standard Python package that fetches a pinned source tarball from PyPI and builds it using conventional tools. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was solely the result of an LLM API error (HTTP 400) when processing the PKGBUILD, not due to any actual security concerns.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool failure rather than a difference in security analysis. The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 error when auditing the PKGBUILD, forcing an inconclusive result for that file and the package as a whole. The deepseek model successfully audited the PKGBUILD and found it completely benign.
coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), leaving the most critical file unaudited in that run.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (such as HTTP 400) to prevent a single transient or format-related failure from rendering the entire package audit inconclusive.
